headline: Sound Like a Native · Foundation
threshold: Carry clear consonant–vowel patterns into natural Spanish words, phrases, and conversation.

lessons.title: Five vowels inside consonant–vowel patterns
lessons.objective: Change Spanish vowel shape inside ma mi mu me mo, then transfer the same movements into other consonant rows and real words.
lessons.focus: Keep each vowel clear inside ma mi mu me mo. Notice the tongue moving forward for mi and back with rounded lips for mu.

words.es: Mira el mapa que está en la mesa.
words.en: Look at the map that is on the table.

words.es: Mi mamá mira la moto desde la casa.
words.en: My mom looks at the motorcycle from the house.

words.es: La moto es de mi amigo Memo.
words.en: The motorcycle belongs to my friend Memo.

words.es: Memo toma una foto de la luna.
words.en: Memo takes a photo of the moon.

lessons.speaking: In Spanish, change Spanish vowel shape inside ma mi mu me mo, then transfer the same movements into other consonant rows and real words. Use the scene: A map at home. Ask a follow-up question and close by confirming the meaning. Keep one sound target clear; a correct transcript is not proof of pronunciation.

lessons.title: The m row
lessons.objective: Move through the five vowels without changing the m.
lessons.focus: Let the lips close lightly for m while the following vowel changes. Compare ma mi mu me mo without inserting a pause inside each unit.

words.es: Memo prepara la maleta para mañana.
words.en: Memo packs the suitcase for tomorrow.

words.es: Lleva una moneda pequeña en la mano.
words.en: He carries a small coin in his hand.

words.es: Su mamá pone música en la cocina.
words.en: His mom plays music in the kitchen.

words.es: Memo mira la maleta una vez más.
words.en: Memo looks at the suitcase one more time.

lessons.speaking: In Spanish, move through the five vowels without changing the m. Use the scene: A morning with Memo. Ask a follow-up question and close by confirming the meaning. Keep one sound target clear; a correct transcript is not proof of pronunciation.

lessons.title: The p row
lessons.objective: Practise a brief p release with less aspiration than a stressed English p.
lessons.focus: Make a small lip closure and release into pa pi pu pe po. Keep the vowels distinct without a strong English-style puff.

words.es: Pablo compra una papa y un poco de pan.
words.en: Pablo buys a potato and a little bread.

words.es: La papa cuesta un peso en esta oferta.
words.en: The potato costs one peso in this offer.

words.es: Una bolsa cae al piso junto a la puerta.
words.en: A bag falls to the floor next to the door.

words.es: Pablo la recoge y pide jugo puro.
words.en: Pablo picks it up and asks for pure juice.

lessons.speaking: In Spanish, practise a brief p release with less aspiration than a stressed English p. Use the scene: Buying fruit. Ask a follow-up question and close by confirming the meaning. Keep one sound target clear; a correct transcript is not proof of pronunciation.

lessons.title: The t row
lessons.focus: Touch lightly near the back of the upper front teeth for t. Practise ta ti tu te to and return to normal stress in Teresa toma té.

words.es: Teresa tiene tiempo para preparar té.
words.en: Teresa has time to make tea.

words.es: Pone una taza junto a la tetera.
words.en: She puts a cup next to the teapot.

words.es: El tubo del filtro está limpio.
Su tía llega y toma la taza.
words.en: Her aunt arrives and takes the cup.

lessons.speaking: In Spanish, find Spanish dental t placement. Use the scene: Tea with Teresa. Ask a follow-up question and close by confirming the meaning. Keep one sound target clear; a correct transcript is not proof of pronunciation.

lessons.title: The n and l rows
lessons.objective: Keep the consonant distinct while changing vowels.
lessons.focus: Alternate na ni nu ne no and la li lu le lo. Keep nasal airflow for n and side airflow for l while the vowel changes.

words.es: Nora deja una nota al lado de la lámpara.
words.en: Nora leaves a note beside the lamp.

words.es: La nota dice que Luis llega esta noche.
words.en: The note says that Luis arrives tonight.

words.es: Luis mira una nube desde la ventana.
words.en: Luis looks at a cloud from the window.

words.es: Luego ve la luna sobre la casa.
words.en: Then he sees the moon above the house.

lessons.speaking: In Spanish, keep the consonant distinct while changing vowels. Use the scene: A note beside the lamp. Ask a follow-up question and close by confirming the meaning. Keep one sound target clear; a correct transcript is not proof of pronunciation.

lessons.title: The s and f rows
lessons.objective: Carry a continuous consonant into a steady vowel.
lessons.focus: Keep continuous airflow through sa si su se so and fa fi fu fe fo. Use the tongue groove for s and light lip-to-teeth narrowing for f.

words.es: La familia se sienta en la sala.
words.en: The family sits in the living room.

words.es: Sofía pone una silla cerca de la mesa.
words.en: Sofía puts a chair near the table.

words.es: Su hermano sirve sopa para todos.
words.en: Her brother serves soup for everyone.

words.es: Felipe trae una foto de la familia.
words.en: Felipe brings a photograph of the family.

lessons.speaking: In Spanish, carry a continuous consonant into a steady vowel. Use the scene: Soup and a photograph. Ask a follow-up question and close by confirming the meaning. Keep one sound target clear; a correct transcript is not proof of pronunciation.

lessons.title: One /k/ sound, two spellings
lessons.objective: Coordinate the back-of-tongue closure and vowel transition in /k/ patterns, then transfer into clear words and phrases.
lessons.focus: Use the tongue back for ka ki ku ke ko. Read the Spanish spellings ca qui cu que co; keep sound cues separate from spelling.

words.es: Quiero una copa de agua y un poco de queso.
words.en: I would like a glass of water and a little cheese.

words.es: Compro queso para comer en casa.
words.en: I buy cheese to eat at home.

words.es: Cerca de la mesa hay una cuna pequeña.
words.en: Near the table there is a small crib.

lessons.speaking: In Spanish, coordinate the back-of-tongue closure and vowel transition in /k/ patterns, then transfer into clear words and phrases. Use the scene: A small café order. Ask a follow-up question and close by confirming the meaning. Keep one sound target clear; a correct transcript is not proof of pronunciation.

lessons.title: One /g/ sound, two spellings
lessons.objective: Read hard g before all five vowels.
lessons.focus: Practise ga gui gu gue go after a pause. Hear the contextual g in mi gato; never replace silent u in gue/gui with an extra vowel.

words.es: El gato duerme cerca de la guitarra.
words.en: The cat sleeps near the guitar.

words.es: Una gota de agua cae sobre la guía.
words.en: A drop of water falls on the guide.

words.es: Guardo la guía antes de salir al jardín.
words.en: I put away the guide before going into the garden.

words.es: Mi amigo toca la guitarra con mucho gusto.
words.en: My friend plays the guitar with great pleasure.

lessons.speaking: In Spanish, read hard g before all five vowels. Use the scene: A guitar in the garden. Ask a follow-up question and close by confirming the meaning. Keep one sound target clear; a correct transcript is not proof of pronunciation.

lessons.title: Ch, ñ, and vowel review
lessons.objective: Build ch and ñ from a model without turning them into letter names.
lessons.focus: Coordinate the brief closure and friction in ch, then the palatal nasal in ñ. Use cha chi chu che cho and ña ñi ñu ñe ño before real words.

words.es: El niño prepara la mochila para mañana.
words.en: The child packs the backpack for tomorrow.

words.es: Su hermana guarda una muñeca pequeña.
words.en: His sister puts away a small doll.

words.es: La mamá sirve leche en una taza.
words.en: The mom serves milk in a cup.

words.es: El niño lleva la mochila hasta la puerta.
words.en: The child carries the backpack to the door.

lessons.speaking: In Spanish, build ch and ñ from a model without turning them into letter names. Use the scene: A child and a small backpack. Ask a follow-up question and close by confirming the meaning. Keep one sound target clear; a correct transcript is not proof of pronunciation.

lessons.title: Foundation transfer check
lessons.objective: Use unfamiliar words and a short passage after mixed sound rows.
lessons.focus: Mix two familiar consonant rows slowly, then say the message without a beat. Check whether vowel clarity transfers to words you did not rehearse.

words.es: Mi amigo quiere ir al parque por la tarde.
words.en: My friend wants to go to the park in the afternoon.

words.es: Miro el mapa y explico el camino.
words.en: I look at the map and explain the route.

words.es: Llevamos comida y una botella de agua.
words.en: We take food and a bottle of water.

words.es: Caminamos juntos hasta la entrada del parque.
words.en: We walk together to the park entrance.

lessons.speaking: In Spanish, use unfamiliar words and a short passage after mixed sound rows. Use the scene: A first clear message. Ask a follow-up question and close by confirming the meaning. Keep one sound target clear; a correct transcript is not proof of pronunciation.
